content:
rachel: Pushed RC artifact rc-2026-04-14-1 -> gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-0414-1. Quick staging smoke good. Planning 21:30 UTC change window. release-notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-0414-1

devin: paste sha and infra pin? any schema changes?

rachel: sha256:77e9c2b, infra pin: infra:v14-lock. No DB schema. FEATURE_STREAM=false until full promote.

haruto: checklist: manifests updated, kv-warm ran, canary route staged, perf smoke?

rachel: kv-warm job 12121 success, canary at 3% staged, perf smoke small-run passed. Dashboards linked in notes.

devin: ops-sheriff on for the window? @ops-sheriff

ops-sheriff: I'll cover 21:30 UTC. fallback: haruto. Runbook ref: /runbooks/rc-standard. Pager hooked to #incidents.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion request queued by rachel. Prechecks: CI=pass, SCA=pass, kv-warm=ok. Canary scheduled 21:30:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 3% -> 15% over 8m -> 45% over 12m -> 100% on green. Auto-abort gates: 5xx > 0.6% OR p99 > +200ms OR downstream vecstore errors >1%.

rachel: staging logs:
```
2026-04-14T20:40:02Z INFO staging start
2026-04-14T20:40:07Z INFO kv warm ok
2026-04-14T20:40:15Z INFO healthcheck ok
```

haruto: initial sample checks at 3% look clean. E2E 20/20 pass.

ops-sheriff: green to ramp to 15%, will hold for manual check at 45%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 15% at 21:38 UTC.

devin: metrics after 10m at 15%: 5xx=0.05%, p99 +35ms, token-cost +6%. embedding calls 0.3% err. OK.

haruto: proceed to 45%. ops-sheriff remember manual hold.

ops-sheriff: placing manual hold at 45% for 10m. watching traces and error budgets.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 45% at 21:50 UTC.

rachel: at 45% after 6m: small spike in p99 to +160ms, but not sustained. 5xx 0.25%. embedding errors spike to 1.2% for 2 minutes then recover.

devin: embedding spike correlated with a downstream cluster overload. ops team rolled a small fix; monitoring. Recommend hold additional 4m.

ops-sheriff: extend hold. if embedding errors >1.5% sustained 5m -> rollback. rollback cmd prepared: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-prev` and patch pin. Deadman auto-fallback at 5m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] hold acknowledged at 21:57 UTC. Canary traffic at 45%.

haruto: downstream team reports full recovery; embedding errors back to 0.2%. p99 back to +60ms.

ops-sheriff: good to proceed to 100% but keep FEATURE_STREAM=false until we observe 30m bake.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promoting to 100% at 22:05:10 UTC. Pre-promotion checks green.

rachel: executing final promote and pin update now. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-0414-1 && kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-0414-1"}}'`

devin: changelog updated, release notes posted.

ops-sheriff: monitoring post-promo 30m. oncall ready. If any gate trips we roll back immediately.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete at 22:06:02 UTC. Live image: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-0414-1.

haruto: post-promo +10m check: p99 +45ms, 5xx 0.04%, embeddings 0.25%. stable.

rachel: RC promoted and release pinned. posting follow-up perf deltas in 24h. thanks team :rocket:

devin: closing thread. metadata: promoted-by=rachel, sheriff=ops-sheriff, tag=rc-0414-1.
